lines.text: The people gathered in the square before the Water Gate, and Ezra read the Law aloud from daybreak until noon.
On the second day, the family heads, priests and Levites gathered around Ezra to study the words of the Law.
They found in the Law that the LORD commanded through Aaron that the Israelites dwell in booths during the feast.
The people brought back branches and made booths on rooftops, in courtyards, and by the Water Gate.
The assembly lived in booths, and Israel had not celebrated like this since the days of King David.
